description: What comes after a health insurance appeal is denied: the next level for the plan type (independent external review, the automatic independent review for Medicare Advantage, a state fair hearing for Medicaid, court), the deadline for it computed from the date of the final denial, and a draft request. Example questions: my insurance appeal was denied, what now; the final denial came, can I still fight it; second appeal denied.

letter_date.description: Date printed on the final denial

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

self_funded.description: Employer plan paid by the employer itself (often 'self-funded', 'claims administrator')

urgent.description: True only if the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health. Never infer it.

name: appeal_denied_again_what_next
title: Appeal denied again: what next
